output.content: I was tracing the traffic flow for the new build and noticed the model serving endpoint has no link to the API gateway. The requests hit the gateway and get a standard not found response. There is no routing rule pointing to the model service. I checked the configuration files and the traffic logs. The logs show zero successful connections to the model layer during the last deployment cycle. The gateway drops these calls before they reach the inference container. No proxy or load balancer is forwarding the traffic. The endpoint exists, but nothing directs users to it. I saw this while testing the CI/CD pipeline output. The deployment succeeded, but the external interface stays silent. The routing table simply lacks the entry for this service right now.
